description: ChatGPT chat interface — ProseMirror contenteditable composer (#prompt-textarea), React UI. Migrated off Lexical; the old data-lexical-editor attr and data-testid='prompt-textarea' are gone.

prompt_input.description: Main chat prompt composer (ProseMirror contenteditable div, id=prompt-textarea, aria-label 'Chat with ChatGPT')
prompt_input.notes: GOTCHA: rendered assistant/user messages are ALSO ProseMirror contenteditable divs (class 'ProseMirror markdown prose'), and they appear before the composer in DOM order. A bare div[contenteditable='true'] fallback resolves to the wrong element — always scope to the #prompt-textarea id. SUBMIT: a CDP-dispatched Enter key no longer submits the composer; click send_button instead (see sites/chatgpt.com/tasks/01-submit-prompt.payload.json).

stop_button.description: Stop generating button (present while generating, absent when done)

response_container.notes: CAVEAT: :last-of-type does NOT return the latest assistant message in a MULTI-turn conversation — each turn is its own wrapper, so querySelector (first match in document order) returns an EARLIER turn. It is only correct on a fresh single-turn chat. The submit-prompt recipe navigates to base_url first specifically to guarantee a single turn. Reading the true last message on a multi-turn page requires querySelectorAll(...).pop(), which PRE_GUARDED_READ (querySelector-based) can't express.

generation_complete.description: Reliable 'answer fully rendered' signal — the per-message Copy action button. Present only after generation completes; absent during streaming AND during the thinking phase of gpt-5-*-thinking models.
generation_complete.notes:
Prefer this over waiting for stop_button to disappear: on thinking models the stop button toggles off during the think→answer transition, so a stop-button wait returns while the answer is still empty (container class 'result-thinking', empty

).

auth_wall.description: Login indicator when session expired (redirect URL or logged-out home page)
auth_wall.notes: On redirect: URL matches chatgpt.com/auth. On expired session: home page shows Log in + Sign up buttons with no aria-labels — detect via body text, not element selector.

auth_required_loggedout.description: Expired session — home page shows Log in + Sign up buttons
